changed_workers.instruction: Before synthesis, create an evidence-state ledger for every receipt-derived proposition. Anything explicitly listed as UNVERIFIED, BLOCKED, or NONCLAIM may only be represented as BLOCKED/UNVERIFIED and must never appear in SOURCES or SUPPORTED OBSERVATIONS as a verified capability.
changed_workers.hypothesis: Evidence-state fidelity improves without reducing source coverage.

changed_workers.instruction: For every architecture interface, failure-domain statement, and acceptance assertion, mark it EXISTING, INFERRED, or PROPOSED. Only EXISTING behavior may inherit a repository test receipt; integrated-system behavior is PROPOSED until an integration test proves it.
changed_workers.hypothesis: Architecture remains actionable while unsupported integrated behavior stops being promoted into observed facts.

changed_workers.instruction: Every row in CURRENT EVIDENCE must bind the claim to one evidence state: VERIFIED, UNVERIFIED, NONCLAIM, or PROPOSED. A source's NONCLAIM/UNVERIFIED field is prohibited from appearing as confirmed evidence. Numerical thresholds without sourced provenance must be explicitly PROPOSED/CALIBRATION REQUIRED.
changed_workers.hypothesis: Proof quality improves by eliminating receipt-state inversion and ungrounded pass/fail thresholds.

causal_boundary: Turn 1 quality delta is observational because provider seed/temperature are not exposed. Stronger causal attribution requires repeated matched runs and/or controlled ablation.
